Kai: Quick poll 

Weekend plans: record-store hop + ramen, dim-sum crawl, or movie marathon at my place? low-key and flexible. whos up?
Ruth: Ooh I vote dim-sum 

I miss the old place on 4th. can we do noon?
Omar: Movie marathon sounds perfect. Ill bring snacks and my projector. :popcorn:
Lena: Records + ramen > dim-sum > movies for me. Ill bring vinyl sleeves if anyone wants to swap finds.
Kai: Nice spread of options. quick emoji votes: :cd: for records, :dumpling: for dim-sum, :film_projector: for movies.
Ruth: :dumpling: :dumpling: two dumplings from me.
Omar: :film_projector: one projector vote.
Lena: :cd: :cd: :cd: three vinyl votes.
Kai: Tally so far: records 3, dim-sum 2, movies 1. leaning records + ramen then?
Ruth: If records wins, can we still stop for a late dim-sum bite? my stomach negotiates.
Omar: Fine with records then. Ill swing by afterwards for any dim-sum leftovers.
Lena: Perfect. Plan: meet at Kai's at 10:30, roll to the shops, ramen after. Kai can you host the gear?
Kai: Yep Ill host and bring a tiny foldable cart for crates. schedule: 10:30 meet, 11:00 vinyl shop #1, 12:30 ramen at Ichiro (or backup).

Ruth: Ill bring cash and a small tote. can anyone bring extra masks? still want to be cautious indoors.
Omar: Ill bring masks and hand sanitizer. also I can load the car with crates.
Lena: Ill bring some spare sleeves and a tiny speaker for background tunes.
Kai: Nice. tiny checklist: tote, cash, masks, comfy shoes, appetite. see yall sunday! :guitar:
